text: loop 是面向 DSH Web 的定时循环插件，通过 /loop 命令和 loop 模型工具按指定间隔向当前 agent 重复投递 prompt，并支持同一会话运行多个循环。用户可以列出或停止循环，模型也可启动、查看和停止任务；对话输入框上方的状态条展示活动循环。设置页可单独关闭模型工具。适合定时轮询、看护 PR 或重复推进构建修复任务；循环状态只保存在当前 harness 进程，退出后清除。

loop is a DSH Web plugin for recurring prompts. Use /loop or its model tool to start and stop multiple scheduled loops for the current agent; the chat status bar shows active loops. The settings page can disable the model tool. Loops exist only in the current process.
想让 DSH 每隔一段时间自动把同一个检查提示发给当前 agent。
我想并行跑几个定时任务，并能随时查看和停止它们。
能不能用一个命令启动周期性 PR 检查，并查看循环状态？
希望对话页能显示正在运行的循环和下一次投递时间。
I want DSH to repeat a prompt to the current agent on a schedule.
Can I start and stop recurring agent tasks from a command or model tool?
loop 的功能「按间隔重复投递 prompt：使用 /loop [interval] <prompt> 或模型 loop 工具启动；任务按设定周期投递到当前 agent，首次启动时会立即尝试投递。
loop 的功能「管理并行循环：可用 /loop list 查看当前 agent 的活动循环，用 /loop stop <id> 停止指定循环，或不带 id 停止全部。
loop 的功能「查看和停止循环：对话页输入框上方显示活动循环状态，可展开多循环列表并通过状态条停止循环。
loop 的循环数据只保存在当前 harness 进程内，进程退出后不会保留；重新启动后需要重新创建循环。
如何让 agent 定时重复执行同一个 prompt？
I need a visible list of active scheduled prompts in my chat.
@vlln/dsh-loop README · Introduction：

@vlln/dsh-loop README · Introduction：Delivers a prompt to the current agent at a fixed interval — ideal for polling, PR babysitting, and build-fix-test cycles. Aligned with Claude Code's `/loop` semantics, **multiple loops can run concurrently in a single session**. Delivered as an official **bundle plugin** (`dsh.bundle` + dshClient channel), 0 patch.

@vlln/dsh-loop README · Features：**Tool** (registered via `defineTool`, the model can self-adjust on every turn):

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `loop` | start (start a new loop) / stop (stop a specific one or all) / status / list (list loops in the current session) |

**Commands** (user side):

@vlln/dsh-loop README · Features：| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/loop [interval] <prompt>` | Start a new loop (interval `5m`/`30s`/`1h`/`2d` or a bare number = minutes; bare `/loop` uses the built-in maintenance prompt) |
| `/loop list` | List all loops in the current session (with ids) |
| `/loop stop <id>` / `/loop stop` | Stop a specific loop / stop all |

@vlln/dsh-loop README · Features：`/loop` replies (the command-palette title/description, `list` / usage / stop output) follow the **UI language**: the client half relays its active locale to the plugin, so they render in Chinese or English to match the interface. Headless runs with no client in sight keep English.

**UI** (dock slot above the input box on the chat page):

@vlln/dsh-loop README · Features：| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| Active status bar | Single loop: `● ⟳ looping · <prompt> · 5m · next in 23s`; multiple loops collapse into a count bar "N loops running · expand", click to expand the list |
| `/` menu row | Typing `/` in the composer shows the ⟳ icon at the left of the `/loop` row (same position and size as every other command row), with a localized title ("Loop" / "循环") |

@vlln/dsh-loop README · Settings：The plugin ships a settings card on **Settings → Plugins → this bundle's page** (official `plugins.bundle.config` slot, keyed by the bundle package name `@vlln/dsh-loop`; the settings namespace is `dsh-loop`, the id of the entry that exports the `Config` schema). **Each tool gets its own row with an official-looking Switch:**

@vlln/dsh-loop README · Settings：The card fields are driven by the client `LOOP_TOOL_FIELDS` table, mirrored one-to-one by the Node-side tool definition table — adding a tool means adding one entry on each side, and the settings card grows a new switch row automatically.

@vlln/dsh-loop README · Settings：Changes apply as soon as you **save** (the schema's leaves are marked `.volatile()`: the host commits in place without remounting the entry and emits `loader/volatile-update`) — the plugin re-reads the snapshot and registers/unregisters the affected tools on the fly, so new sessions pick it up without a restart. Tool schemas are resolved live at every session/prompt assembly (there is no per-session snapshot): in-flight sessions also see the change from their next turn, and turning a tool off drops it from `tools.schemas` immediately, so a model that called it earlier can no longer reach it (they can only reconcile that through the turn record). The `/loop` command (user side) and the status bar are unaffected.

@vlln/dsh-loop README · to track the latest commit instead: dsh plugin --profile web add "github:vlln/dsh-loop#main"：```

Or from a local directory (when you have the source): `git clone`, then `cd dsh-loop && dsh plugin --profile web add .`.

@vlln/dsh-loop README · Compatibility：| dsh version | Status |
|---|---|
| `0.2.0-rc.2` | ✅ Verified (migrated against 0.2.0 on 2026-10-03; command surface re-checked 2026-10-15) |
| Other versions | ⚠️ Unverified — if the `/loop` menu row loses its icon and localized title after a dsh upgrade (the command itself still works), upstream renamed an internal client command-surface method and the plugin silently falls back to the official fallback look |

@vlln/dsh-loop README · Compatibility：After installing, **restart web** for it to take effect (bundles are composed at startup); afterwards you can disable/enable it from the "Plugins" panel on the settings page (takes effect at runtime + persisted).
@vlln/dsh-loop README · Usage：```sh

@vlln/dsh-loop README · User side：/loop 5m check PRs on the deploy branch   # delivered every 5 minutes
/loop list                                # loop-1: every 5m — check PRs on the deploy branch
/loop stop loop-1                         # stop a specific one
/loop stop                                # stop all

@vlln/dsh-loop README · Model side (loop tool)：loop action=start prompt="fix flaky test" interval="2m"
loop action=status
loop action=stop loop_id="loop-2"
```

Loops live in the current harness process and disappear when the process exits (not persisted across restarts, consistent with Claude Code `/loop`).

@vlln/dsh-loop README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run build      # tsdown: Node half (lib/index.mjs) + client bundle (lib/client.js)
```

- Node half: `src/index.mjs` (commands/tool/loops status route `/plugins/dsh-loop/loops`)
- client: `src/client/index.tsx` (dock slot status bar)
